However, we have a restriction: all three lanes must be occupied.

By the Principle of Inclusion-Exclusion (PIE), the number of such assignments is:
$|Total| - |A \cup B \cup C| = |Total| - (|A| + |B| + |C|) + (|A \cap B| + |A \cap C| + |B \cap C|) - |A \cap B \cap C|$.

4. $|A \cap B \cap C|$: All lanes are empty. This is impossible since there are cars. So $0^6 = 0$.
